citation: Laansma et al., 2021, An International Multicenter Analysis of Brain Structure Across Clinical Stages of Parkinson's Disease
phenotype: PD-control cortical thickness and subcortical volume standardized effects
anatomical_regions: 68 bilateral cortical parcels and 16 bilateral subcortical structures
measurement_method: 3T/1.5T T1 MRI; FreeSurfer 5.3; multisite linear mixed-effects mega-analysis
disease_stage: Hoehn and Yahr 1-5; primary contrast all PD vs controls
independent_status: Independent phenotype and analysis; no AHBA or GENE2BRAIN use; exact participant-disjointness from the upstream GWAS cannot be guaranteed because PPMI is one of 19 imaging sites and contributes genetic data to PD consortia
numerical_data: Yes; official ENIGMA Toolbox CSV summary statistics
atlas_coordinate_system: Desikan-Killiany cortex plus FreeSurfer aseg subcortex; hemisphere-specific
decision_reason: Largest directly measured PD-control phenotype with public machine-readable standardized regional effects and bilateral cortical/subcortical coverage; selected without inspecting correlation

citation: Zeighami et al., 2015, Network structure of brain atrophy in de novo Parkinson's disease
phenotype: Deformation-based morphometry PD-related ICA atrophy-network loading
anatomical_regions: Whole-brain voxelwise map; 112 regions used in published secondary analysis
measurement_method: 3T T1 MRI; deformation-based morphometry; independent component analysis
independent_status: Independent imaging phenotype and no AHBA use; PPMI participants may overlap an upstream GWAS component
numerical_data: Voxelwise ICA component map is public; direct regional PD-control t-statistic vector is not released
atlas_coordinate_system: MNI voxel map; Hammers plus additional subcortical/cerebellar atlas in paper
decision_reason: Excellent spatial coverage including substantia nigra but public voxel values are ICA component Z-scores rather than direct PD-control effects; possible PPMI participant overlap

citation: Frigerio et al., 2024, Regional differences in synaptic degeneration are linked to alpha-synuclein burden and axonal damage in Parkinson's disease and dementia with Lewy bodies
dataset: Netherlands Brain Bank and Normal Aging Brain Collection Amsterdam
phenotype: Synaptophysin and SV2A puncta density; Lewy body density; NfL immunoreactivity
independent_status: Independent postmortem donors; no known overlap with discovery GWAS or AHBA
numerical_data: No reusable region-level numerical table; supplements provide donor data, model summaries and figures
decision_reason: Strong biological independence but only eight cortical regions and no machine-readable regional phenotype; graph digitization was prohibited

citation: Kerestes et al., 2023, Cerebellar Volume and Disease Staging in Parkinson's Disease
phenotype: PD-control and stage-specific cerebellar lobule volume effects
measurement_method: 3D T1 MRI; deep-learning cerebellar parcellation; multisite mixed-effects models
independent_status: Independent phenotype and analysis; cohort overlap with discovery-GWAS contributors cannot be excluded
numerical_data: Published numerical supplement/figures; no broader noncerebellar phenotype
decision_reason: Large sample but validation is restricted to cerebellum and does not test the whole-brain discovery pattern

citation: Owens-Walton et al., 2024, A worldwide study of white matter microstructural alterations in people living with Parkinson's disease
phenotype: PD-control fractional anisotropy and mean diffusivity effects
measurement_method: Diffusion MRI; ENIGMA-DTI tract-based spatial statistics
independent_status: Independent phenotype and analysis; cohort overlap with discovery-GWAS contributors cannot be excluded
numerical_data: Published regional statistics but gray-matter mapping is indirect
decision_reason: White-matter tract measurements cannot be mapped to AAL3 gray-matter parcels without imposing an indirect connectivity model
